title: External Search API Integrations
summary: This module provides tools for integrating with various third-party search APIs like Exa, SerpApi, and Serper.dev, enabling agents to perform web searches, news searches, and retrieve structured search results.

nodes.label: Exa Search Tool (Deprecated)
nodes.title: EXASearchTool
nodes.description: A deprecated tool for performing web searches via the Exa API, issuing warnings upon use and delegating to the current ExaSearchTool implementation.

nodes.label: SerpApi Base Tool
nodes.title: SerpApiBaseTool
nodes.description: Provides foundational integration with the SerpApi service, handling API key management, client initialization, and filtering of search results using regular expressions.

nodes.label: Serper.dev Search Tool
nodes.title: SerperDevTool
nodes.description: Facilitates web and news searches through the Serper.dev API, managing API requests, processing JSON responses, and formatting various types of search results.

nodes.label: Base Tool Component
nodes.title: BaseTool
nodes.description: The abstract base class providing common functionalities and structure for all tools within the CrewAI framework.

nodes.label: Exa Search API
nodes.title: Exa Search API
nodes.description: An external web search service that provides search results.

nodes.label: SerpApi Service
nodes.title: SerpApi
nodes.description: An external search engine results API that provides structured data from various search engines.

nodes.label: Serper.dev API
nodes.title: Serper.dev
nodes.description: An external API for Google Search results, including web and news searches.

nodes.label: HTTP Request Client
nodes.title: requests library
nodes.description: A utility for making synchronous HTTP requests to external web services and APIs.

nodes.label: Environment Variable Manager
nodes.title: os module
nodes.description: Manages access to system environment variables, typically used for retrieving sensitive API keys and configurations.

nodes.label: JSON Data Parser
nodes.title: json module
nodes.description: Handles the serialization and deserialization of JSON data, crucial for processing API responses.

nodes.label: Deprecation Warning Logger
nodes.title: warnings module
nodes.description: A standard Python module used to issue warnings, particularly for notifying users about deprecated functionalities.

nodes.label: Regular Expression Processor
nodes.title: re module
nodes.description: Provides operations for regular expression matching, used here for pattern-based data manipulation and filtering.

groups.label: Third-Party Search Tools
groups.title: Third-Party Search Tools
groups.description: Components that provide specialized search capabilities by integrating with various external search APIs.

groups.label: External Search Services
groups.title: External Search Services
groups.description: External APIs and services that the search tools interact with to retrieve information.

groups.label: Core Tool Framework
groups.title: Core Tool Framework
groups.description: The foundational components that define the structure and common behavior for all tools.

groups.label: System & Data Utilities
groups.title: System & Data Utilities
groups.description: Standard Python modules and libraries used for common tasks like HTTP communication, environment variable management, JSON processing, and warning handling.
